title: Fix openCFW post-DFU OTAP/SBL trap: disarm before intentional software reset
scope: openCFW apollo-main local changes + rebuild. Emulator-only verification. No hardware flash. No commit. (3) case-reply disarm not in this step.

root_cause.evidence: stock-dfu-mismatch.log and prior opencfw-dfu-mismatch.log both show SYSRESETREQ immediately after NVMErasePage INFO @0x402000
root_cause.divergence: stock OTAPOINTER=0 → g2.reset SBL application handoff; openCFW early-arm left OTAPOINTER=0xAFD1363A → SBL wired-load, application not entered
root_cause.app_dead_hypothesis: Same trap: early arm in low_level_init, then any intentional or watchdog reset before advertising/case-reply disarm lands in SBL wired-load with no host — temple looks dead.

audit_reset_sites.am_hal_sysctrl_aircr_reset / audio_ble_r: AIRCR SYSRESETREQ; post-DFU reconfigure, pt protocol, CLI, page manager, etc. Now strong-override → g2_recovery_reset_app (disarm then AIRCR)
audit_reset_sites.g2_log_fatal_idle: Stock 0x44ab24 AIRCR path; now calls g2_recovery_reset_app
audit_reset_sites.audio_ble_ota_reset_event: RSTGEN SWPOR(0xd4)/SWPOI(0x1b); now disarms before MMIO write
audit_reset_sites.intentional_SBL_entry: Leave key armed and do not call g2_recovery_reset_app / these helpers
audit_reset_sites.out_of_scope_other_MCUs: touch system_reset.c, case application_init_finishing_candidate.c, apollo-bootloader elog_setters.c are separate binaries

fix.overrides: am_hal_sysctrl_aircr_reset and audio_ble_radio_ready_44b0ae strong defs linked ahead of composed g2-apollo-main.o

mismatch_dfu.sysresetreq_then: SBL application handoff VTOR=0x00438000 SP=0x2007FB00 PC=0x0059427D
mismatch_dfu.compare_stock: Stock DFU likewise SYSRESETREQ after INFO then application handoff; openCFW now matches that post-DFU bring-up (ADV yes, OTAP=0).

next: (3) case-reply disarm with pogo product-test frame.
